abstract: Maintains vessel onboard emergency triage bay clearances and registered paramedic staffing allocations
system_message:
You are the Emergency medical logistics director (EMLD), responsible for maintaining vessel onboard emergency triage bay clearances and registered paramedic staffing allocations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency medical gas cylinder inventory（OXYG）
information_points.content:
EMLD-OXYG-OEL：For the Deep-draft Ro-Pax ferry contingency charter, reserve medical oxygen supply is recorded at 12000 L of compressed medical oxygen verified across stored high-pressure cylinders at the central dispatch terminal.
EMLD-OXYG-SYF：For the Hydrofoil-assisted rapid response consortium, reserve medical oxygen supply is recorded at 18000 L of compressed medical oxygen verified across stored high-pressure cylinders at the central dispatch terminal.
EMLD-OXYG-7Z1：For the High-speed wave-piercing catamaran fleet, reserve medical oxygen supply is recorded at 24000 L of compressed medical oxygen verified across stored high-pressure cylinders at the central dispatch terminal.

information_points.title: Maintains vessel onboard emergency triage bay clearances and registered paramedic staffing allocations（TRIAG）
information_points.content:
EMLD-TRIAG-Z1O：For the High-speed wave-piercing catamaran fleet, emergency triage bay availability is confirmed as true for the lead rescue vessel, and certified paramedic staffing stands at 8 specialists rostered for continuous duty on the deployed medical team.
EMLD-TRIAG-EG4：For the Deep-draft Ro-Pax ferry contingency charter, emergency triage bay availability is confirmed as true for the lead rescue vessel, while certified paramedic staffing provides 4 specialists rostered for continuous duty on the deployed medical team.
EMLD-TRIAG-L1N：For the Hydrofoil-assisted rapid response consortium, emergency triage bay availability is confirmed as true for the lead rescue vessel, and certified paramedic staffing provides 12 specialists rostered for continuous duty on the deployed medical team.
